title: Sealed Class Advantage
instructions: What is the main advantage of sealed classes over regular open classes with inheritance?

options.text: Sealed classes are faster at runtime than regular classes
Sealed classes allow you to create more subclasses than regular classes
The compiler can check that your when expression handles all possible types, preventing missed cases
Sealed classes use less memory than regular classes

explanation: Because direct subclasses of a sealed class are restricted to the same package and module, the compiler knows every possible direct type. They may be declared in separate files. A when expression can therefore be checked for every case, unlike a hierarchy rooted in a regular open class.
